statements.t: • Total Revenue for Q1 was $559 million, an increase of $8 million or 2% year-over-year and $4 million above the midpoint of our guidance range.
• Ending Paid Connected Fitness Subscriptions were 2.475 million, a decrease of 9% year-over-year and at the top of our guidance range.
• Total Gross Margin was 61.3% in Q1, representing a year-over-year increase of 975 basis points and above our guidance of 57%, partially driven by nonrecurring benefits.

Our purposeful innovation has enabled us to target the multibillion-dollar at-home treadmill market with our best products and broadest price range ever, advance digital personalized training through Peloton IQ, and launch the Peloton Commercial Series to meet Members wherever they train,” said Peter Stern, Peloton's CEO and President.
Below is our outlook for Q2 and Full Year fiscal 2027.
We intend to provide further details on our outlook during today’s earnings conference call.
• Total Revenue outlook of $2.30 billion to $2.40 billion, representing a decrease of $96 million or 4% year-over-year at the midpoint and no change to our outlook provided last quarter.
• Total Gross Margin outlook of approximately 54.0%, reflecting an increase of 140 basis points year-over-year and no change to our outlook provided last quarter.
• Adjusted EBITDA outlook of $475 million to $525 million, representing an increase of $32 million or 7% year-over-year at the midpoint and no change to our outlook provided last quarter.
• Free Cash Flow of at least $350 million, no change from our minimum target provided last quarter.

A live webcast of the call and our earnings presentation will be available at https://investor.onepeloton.com/news-and-events/events and a replay will be available on the investor relations page of our website for 30 days.

Consistent with industry practice, we acquire inventories from these suppliers through purchase orders against which orders are applied based on projected demand information and availability of goods.
Such purchase commitments typically cover our forecasted product and manufacturing requirements for periods that span a number of months.

While our purchase orders are legally cancellable in many situations, some purchase orders are not cancellable in the event of a demand plan change or other circumstances, such as where the supplier has procured unique, Peloton- and Precor-specific designs, and/or specific non-cancelable, non-returnable components based on our provided forecasts.

The Company assesses the likelihood that its deferred tax assets will be recovered from future taxable income and, to the extent the Company believes recovery of its deferred tax assets is not more-likely-than-not, a valuation allowance is established.

The Company recognizes the tax benefit from an uncertain tax position only if it is more likely than not the tax position will be sustained on examination by the taxing authorities based on the technical merits of the position.
Based on management’s assessment of historical results and forecasts, management is continuously monitoring the weight of both positive and negative evidence.

The Company will continue to maintain a valuation allowance against deferred tax assets where we believe that it is more likely than not that they will not be realized.

estimates.name: Income Taxes
estimates.t: Management makes estimates, assumptions, and judgments to determine the Company’s provision for income taxes, deferred tax assets and liabilities, and any valuation allowance recorded against deferred tax assets.
